name: C'mon Do Something
look: A crude black-and-white line drawing on a white background. A tall, thin, pale figure with a dark band across its eyes hunches over and pokes at the ground with a long stick, leaving empty space at the stick's tip on the right.
use: Poking something lifeless or unresponsive, hoping it will react. The figure is labeled as the person, and the thing at the end of the stick is whatever refuses to do anything, such as a dead project or a quiet group chat.
slots: the unresponsive thing being poked (at the stick's tip)
examples: The tracking number that hasn't updated in four days
describe: stick figure poking something with a stick
drawing of a guy poking a dead thing to see if it moves
tall skinny man prodding the ground with a long stick
poking it with a stick saying come on do something
crude doodle of someone jabbing at something with a stick
